Terms and Conditions
1) I understand that it is mandatory for COLABS applicants to obtain Consent of Acceptance
from one prospective academic advisor beforehand as it is a research-oriented program.
*
2) I understand that obtaining the above-mentioned consent does not guarantee acceptance to the COLABS program.
*
3) I understand that failure to submit any of the application materials to TAO (incomplete applications)
shall result in disqualification from further screening procedures, regardless of whether the above-mentioned consent
was obtained.
*
4) I promise that all information I provide in my application and related materials are true and correct.
*
5) I promise that both during and after my participation in the COLABS program at Tohoku University,
I will be enrolled as　a full-time master's degree seeking student with excellent grades at my home university.
